frame_change.characteristics: C_+(z)=L(z) C_-(z) R(z) with L,R invertible source-derived boundary frame maps
frame_change.physical_transport: gamma_+(z) R(z)^-1=U(z) gamma_-(z), where U is the interior reciprocal transport

determinant_transition.graded: replace determinants by determinant-line characters/Berezinians, with the Euler block in dual degree
determinant_transition.transition: g_+-=Det(L)Det(R) with parity exponents dictated by the graded complex

adjugate_transition.verification: C_+ times the displayed right side equals det(C_+)I, and similarly on the other side
adjugate_transition.meaning: the adjugate carries both the determinant-line transition and the contragredient right/left kernel frame changes

cofactor_variation.fixed_frame_variation: if dot C_+=L dot C_- R, then Tr(adj(C_+) dot C_+)=det(L)det(R)Tr(adj(C_-)dot C_-)
cofactor_variation.moving_frames: z-derivatives add d log Det(L)+d log Det(R) to the logarithmic determinant derivative
cofactor_variation.interpretation: those extra terms are exactly transition-connection/anomaly currents, not changes in the kernel divisor

regularized_anomaly.det3: raw det3 is not multiplicative; its defect alpha_3 is the coboundary delta r of r(A)=-Tr A+(1/2)Tr A^2
regularized_anomaly.normalization: Delta_3=e^-r det3 is a strict character at finite cutoff
regularized_anomaly.higher_coherence: the primitive and square lines provide the 2-cochain r whose coboundary cancels the associativity/transition anomaly
regularized_anomaly.result: after anomaly normalization, determinant and adjugate transitions can satisfy the same Cech cocycle law

obstruction_cocycles.scalar: eta_+-=g_+-,declared/[Det(L)Det(R)]; eta must be the unit section one in the common determinant frame
obstruction_cocycles.kernel: a_+-=Adj_+-g_+- R^-1 Adj_- L^-1; this must vanish as a determinant-line-valued Hom section
obstruction_cocycles.Poisson: p_+-=gamma_+R^-1-U gamma_-; this must vanish on the characteristic kernel/root-chain sheaf
obstruction_cocycles.relation: scalar eta=1 does not imply a=p=0; simultaneous descent is the missing mate coherence

multiple_zeros.moving_R: parameter derivatives of c_+=R^-1c_- mix root vectors by a triangular jet transformation
multiple_zeros.preservation: invertibility and holomorphy of R preserve local cokernel length and Jordan/root-chain multiplicity
multiple_zeros.requirement: the full cofactor/minor complex, not only ordinary adjugate at one point, must obey the transition

opposite_face_gluing: The plus and minus Weyl faces glue with opposite orientations because their common boundary frame maps enter contragrediently. Determinant scalarization is the quotient by Det(L)Det(R), while kernel gluing is the simultaneous quotient by R^-1 and L^-1. Their compatibility is exactly the higher coherence joining the two faces.
next_iteration: Apply these formulas to reciprocal sewing, where L and R are built from W_FP and its contragredient. Determine the determinant-line character of W_FP, including endpoint Maslov/Tate phase, and test whether its fourth cyclic product is one or leaves an orientation holonomy.
iteration_result: The determinant and kernel transitions are not separate mysteries. For C_+=L C_- R, one exact adjugate formula contains both. In completion, the only new obstruction is the regularized multiplicative anomaly, already typed by primitive and square lines. The true mate condition is simultaneous vanishing of scalar, adjugate, and Poisson Cech defects after that normalization.
